SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rtrim(lower(o.status)) = 'shipped' THEN o.amount ELSE CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) END) AS shipped_amt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rtrim(lower(o.status)) = 'pending' THEN o.amount ELSE CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) END) AS pending_amt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rtrim(lower(o.status)) = 'cancelled' THEN o.amount ELSE CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) END) AS cancelled_amt,
    MAX(o.order_date) AS last_order,
    COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders
FROM {{ source('legacy', 'customers') }} c
LEFT JOIN {{ source('legacy', 'orders') }} o
    ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id

explanation: This procedure builds a per-customer scorecard by joining every customer to their orders, including customers with no orders. For each customer it totals order amounts by status (shipped, pending, cancelled), records the date of the most recent order, and counts orders. The result is written to the customer_scorecard table, replacing any previous version.
